title: Assumption-contrast inquiry
statement: For a consequential product decision bounded by authored possibilities, an agent can use a scenario-conditioned evaluation view within the assumption-aware opportunity ecology to project which visible candidates depend on each assumption, identify unassessed candidates and shared-assumption groups, and decide whether the contrast warrants a new direction; the view does not generate, rank, select or authorize.

alignment.basis: ADR 0037's domain-general cognitive development and the active agent's ownership of semantic judgment support assumption-aware prospective reasoning.

ambition.basis: A read-only evaluation variant within the existing assumption-aware ecology, not a distinct generative direction; a fresh evaluation found it too narrow to be substantial.

horizon.basis: Existing possibility records, one-hop ecology relationships, the new contrast operation and a portable procedure supply the pieces; independent use is unobserved.

realization.basis: The read-only contrast and portable procedure exist at 13bc8a2f, but a fresh evaluation at bafa004b judged this candidate too narrow and overlapping with poss:assumption-aware-opportunity-ecology. It was narrowed and remains hypothetical; no independent use or benefit is established.

synthesis_basis: At 13bc8a2f, goal:compounding-product-knowledge had five direct candidates (one unassessed, two partial); goal:domain-general-cognitive-development had nine inherited candidates (five unassessed, two partial). Shared assumptions lacked direct relations and the existing assumption-aware candidate had no authored assumptions. A fresh evaluation at bafa004b judged this candidate too narrow and overlapping; it is retained as an incremental evaluation variant, not a distinct substantial direction.
value_hypothesis: A later agent can use a compact scenario-conditioned view to inspect whether its option set is bounded by authored assumptions and to decide whether to continue, reframe, author a candidate or stop.
revisit_when: An authentic decision uses the contrast to change or confirm a construction direction, and a later agent evaluates whether it reduced missed alternatives or false assumptions.
counterevidence: Existing possibility-ecology exposes one-hop assumptions; a fresh evaluation at bafa004b judged this candidate a too-narrow variant of poss:assumption-aware-opportunity-ecology, noted that the cross-episode assumption was not load-bearing, and found no decision-changing use. The read-only contrast is useful as a compact view, not new semantic information; one same-agent use does not establish benefit.
claim_ceiling: Incremental evaluation variant of the assumption-aware opportunity ecology; read-only contrast and procedure implemented; no distinct product direction, independent later-agent use, decision benefit, comparative advantage or authorization.
